description: November 11 birthday meaning: Scorpio decan 2, birthday number 11, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a November 11 birthday falls in Scorpio, in the second decan, with Pluto as the sign's ruler and Neptune as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 11. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Scorpio is fixed and water.

sections.heading: Personality of a November 11 birthday
paragraphs: Eleven twice over: November 11 is the eleventh day of the eleventh month, and numerologists keep 11 as a master number linked with intuition. Eighteen degrees of Scorpio sits under Neptune's influence too, so sensitivity is heightened in every direction. The interpretive picture is a deeply perceptive, spiritually curious person who needs creative outlets to stay grounded.

By noon UTC on November 11, the Sun has normally reached roughly 18° of Scorpio. That places the date in the Scorpio decan that astrologers give to Neptune, the second of three. From 10 to 19 degrees of Scorpio, the sub-ruler is Neptune, modern ruler of Pisces. Early-to-mid November birthdays tend to soften the sign's intensity with intuition, imagination and empathy. These Scorpios are often seen as perceptive in an almost uncanny way, reading undercurrents in a room and drawn to art, healing work or spiritual questions. Neptune can blur edges, so feelings may be absorbed from others or idealised beyond recognition. The combination is powerful when grounded: deep emotional insight paired with compassion, used to help people face what they would rather not see alone.

sections.heading: Numerology of the November 11 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 11th, you have a birthday number of 11, and because it is a master number it stays unreduced. The day of birth is a secondary number in numerology, yet master numbers are traditionally given extra weight wherever they appear. Two 1s side by side suggest doubled sensitivity as well as doubled initiative: the 11 is linked with intuition, inspiration and a nervous, creative charge. Those born on this date are often described as idealistic and perceptive, sometimes picking up on things before they can explain why. Grounding routines and trusted company tend to help them carry that intensity comfortably.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same November 11 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 4 for 1980, 5 for 1990, 6 for 2000 and 7 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 33. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: November 11 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 11 is the 315th day of the year (316th in a leap year). In most years Sagittarius season is under way by November 23, 12 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a November 11 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. November 11 is also the birthday of Fyodor Dostoyevsky (1821), Leonardo DiCaprio (1974) and Kurt Vonnegut (1922).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 11?
faq.answer: November 11 is Scorpio in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Scorpio, which tradition links with Neptune.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 11?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 11 the Life Path is 11 in 1960, 3 in 1970, 4 in 1980, 5 in 1990, 6 in 2000, 7 in 2010 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 11 for everyone born on the 11th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 11?
faq.answer: By November 11 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 11?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a November 11 birthday are Fyodor Dostoyevsky (1821), Leonardo DiCaprio (1974) and Kurt Vonnegut (1922). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
